## Staff tools (Labs 13–15)
Three follow-on labs pair with this book's harness chapters and ship a reference implementation in this repository's `tools/` folder:
- Lab 13, Close the Gate: the five-gate check (`tools/slop_check.py`)
- Lab 14, The Paper Trail: the evidence-trio linter (`tools/trio_lint.py`)
- Lab 15, The Doctor Is In: environment pre-flight (`tools/lab_doctor.py`)

## Agents and skills
- Named path in the labs: [pi](https://pi.dev); any CLI agent works
- Jake Van Clief and David McDermott, *Interpretable Context Methodology: Folder Structure as Agent Architecture* (2026): the folders-over-agents framing and numbered stage workspaces: [arxiv.org/html/2603.16021v2](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.16021v2)
- Anthropic Agent Skills documentation: the skill-folder architecture of Chapter 12
- Boris Cherny / Claude Code guidance on AI slop and the mini-CEO role (2026): see Chapter 2
